smart-access.heroDesc: Smart Access is TimeFlow's complete solution for managing the company's physical access and permissions. The module provides full control over keys, access cards, key fobs, tags and digital access for customers, properties, projects, service vans and the company's own premises. With full traceability at individual level, you always know who has which access, where it is used, when it was issued and when it should be returned. Smart Access reduces security risks, simplifies administration and ensures that the right person has the right permission at the right time.
